tickets.title: Recompose Barras into an enclosed branching hall/market junction

original_fields.Priority / milestone / owner / BA: P0 · F2.2 · LD; environment architect for visible native enclosure · independent topology reviewer + QE/BA.
original_fields.Dependencies: GLC-01 current gap/hall input evidence; current finite legacy bearing/body clearance; source-proposal review and private geometry slot. No copying of another game's layout.
original_fields.Problem / resulting behavior: The hall line, southern bank/seat and market aisles act as islands. Reuse them around a compact court where a hall landing can choose bank/Manual, seat grind or useful glancing wallride/Wallie, then return toward hall/market or branch to the Clyde mouth.
original_fields.Private design to implement: Bank `(91,0,8)`, yaw−π/2, native X89…93/Z1…15 with plateau Z5…11/Y0.55. Existing 10 m seat X79…89 goes to **Z26**; Z19 was rejected because its cap would be only0.69 m from the current C04 hall landing. Fold the existing 36 m southern boundary to `(50,30.8)→(72,30.8)→(72,44.8)`, preserving18 native panels/19 points and resampling **both** legs. Use the horizontal22 m face for a west-going oblique wallride and northward Wallie; the 14 m south-going leg is not a useful exit.
original_fields.Acceptance: Actual loading/hall→seat→finite glancing wallride/Wallie→supported forecourt landing/next action with ordinary input, actual meaningful intervals and honest single-bank/two-bank labels. Native display/collision/query/audio/guide/feature transforms atomic; all ground/air/shoulder/maximum-charged misses deliberate. Preserve X83 hall return, X103 west aisle, X114 covered aisle, Z22 crossing, X86…102 Clyde mouth, recording and all Mairi/career gates. Visible/native wall height needs real containment proof; a proposed 5 m face is not pre-certified.
original_fields.Verification: Independent topology reviewer derives every body/guide/shape AABB and protected path from current source. QE drives both useful directions, no-pop/late-pop/lateral/upper-wall misses and all career/mission approaches. BA inspects matched overview/chase/full-speed line and checks the court creates distinct choices rather than repetitive bank modules.
original_fields.Evidence: [Exact unbuilt source proposal and partial independent source review](../levels/BARRAS-JUNCTION-PROPOSAL-2026-11-07/README.md), existing C04 hall through-run, all-gap audit. No native layout or resource pass exists for this proposal.
original_fields.Budget: Reuse existing bank, seat, wall body/18 native shape slots/materials; keep all55 protected opaque prisms unchanged. Proposed enclosure display must reuse existing unit Box/MultiMesh resources without increasing unique mesh/material/texture/light counts; source triangle reductions alone are not cost admission. Measure current body/shape/draw/mesh/memory and actual performance after native/moving admission.
